verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is an online IP filing and registry service. Such a portal could plausibly offer event-triggered rules, such as watch alerts on new publications in the Boletim da Propriedade Industrial or automatic renewal or annuity reminders, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes manual filing procedures (applications, renewals, oppositions, publication deferral) and shows no user-definable rules or automated actions triggered by events.
